title: TinyN
description: A lightweight vanilla+ modpack with Create. Made for a private SMP server.
body:
TinyN is a modpack created for the use on a private SMP server.

Its aims are to:
- have at least [vanilla-like performance](https://https//github.com/NyxWinter/TinyN/blob/main/performance-testing.md)
- improve the ability to make a pretty house
- decrease the boredom of the vanilla experience, without changing the feel too much
- provide some QOL features
- improve the cuteness of the game

## Notable mods used
The mods that are most essential to the pack are, in no particular order:
- Create (+addons)
- Nature's Spirit
- Farmer's Delight (+addons)
- Chipped
- Tom's Simple Storage Mod
- You're in Grave Danger

## Performance notes
If used with particularly low-end hardware (or high-res displays), it might be necessary to make use of the RenderScale mod.

## Server-Side recommendations
This list won't "just work" server-side, due to some mods that expect a display. It's also more fun to play with some extra structure generation mods!

### List of mods to remove:
- Sodium
- Sodium Extra
- Reese's Sodium Options
- Flerovium
- McQoy
- Emi++
- Continuity
- Controlling
- Dynamic FPS
- LambDynamicLights
- Mod Menu (NeoForge Edition)
- WI Zoom

With these gone, it should at least /start/. That doesn't mean there are no unnecessary mods left.

### List of recommended server-side mods:
- YUNG's Better {Nether Fortresses, Mineshafts, Strongholds, Witch Huts, Bridges}
- Explorify
- Chunky (for pre-generating chunks)
- Structory
- Simple Backups
- Dungeons and Taverns
